THE_THREE_CLAIMS_TO_JUDGE.1_the_chain_stops_here_and_at_what_grade: The producer reports the immunogen stated once and unambiguously as a GST fusion to WWOX residues 12-94 containing both WW domains, and concludes this DISSOLVES the two-description discrepancy in PMID 15982416 rather than adjudicating it — insert and fusion partner, both true of one construct — so an earlier IPOTESI becomes DATO. It further reports, by count over the full text, zero immunohistochemistry, zero pre-immune, isotype, peptide-block, pre-absorption, no-primary, second-antibody and knockdown controls, with the word 'antibody' appearing once in the article. Verify the immunogen sentence verbatim, and verify the absences as absences — an absence claim is the easiest thing to get wrong in either direction.
THE_THREE_CLAIMS_TO_JUDGE.2_the_epitope_deletion_geometry: 🔴 This is the claim with the longest reach, because it bears on how much the two 2005 papers' genetic null is worth. The producer reports: the epitope sits in exons 1-3 (N-terminal, confirmed against this paper's own figure at 4200x3703, WW1 from L17 and WW2 to about P86); PEO1's recorded lesion deletes exons 4-8, DOWNSTREAM of the epitope; the paper's wording is the careful 'does not produce full-length WWOX'; and the null lane is NOT blank, carrying a faint higher-molecular-weight band. It records the consequence as IPOTESI with a REVIVAL_TRIGGER and deliberately NOT as DATO, because the band is unidentified and non-specific background is an adequate competing explanation. Judge each component, and judge whether IPOTESI is the right strength — over-reading this would weaken a control that may be sound, and under-reading it would leave a reagent argument resting on a control the geometry undercuts.
THE_THREE_CLAIMS_TO_JUDGE.3_the_missing_ladder: The producer reports that the specificity panel itself carries no molecular-weight marks at all, that the paper's only two marks sit on a different blot bracketing the band 45.5 kd apart, and that the '~46 kDa' attribution is therefore unverifiable on the panel asserting it. Verify at the resolution the anchor names.
THE_THREE_CLAIMS_TO_JUDGE.4_the_genre_finding: It reports three assertions carried in the abstract or captions WITHOUT the 'manuscript in preparation', 'unpublished observation' and 'data not shown' qualifiers the body gives them, plus a 'necessary and sufficient' conclusion where only necessity is shown and a caption cross-referencing a figure that does not exist. The same genre failure mode was found in PMID 24932569 earlier in this batch, so judge whether it is genuinely present here or whether pattern-matching supplied it.

ALSO_TO_JUDGE: Each proposition against its source at the declared digest; material omissions; comparisons; citation CONTEXT rather than existence; coverage honesty — including the producer's declaration that supplementaryFiles returned 'not open access one' in agreement with hasSuppl=N, so there is no supplement to declare, and its declaration that 36 of about 56 references are UNSCREENED with Crossref exposing 20.
THE_RULE_THAT_PROTECTS_THE_TRUTH: 🔴 A verifier finding can itself be wrong, including your own earlier passes'. You have withdrawn six of your own findings across this batch — four in W4 alone — and each withdrawal was worth more than the finding it replaced. Re-open the named surface at the resolution the anchor gives before recording anything as unsupported. Never ask for a true statement to be deleted because a check disagrees with it; DISAGREEMENT_UNRESOLVED with both readings stated is the honest output where the artefact is ambiguous. If the work is sound, say so plainly.

the_four_claims.1_chain_stops_here_and_at_what_grade: CONFIRMED. Immunogen byte-exact and stated once ('GST fusion' 1x, '12-94' 1x). Absences verified term by term as absences: antibody 1, immunohistochem 0, immunostain 0, pre-immune 0, isotype 0, peptide-block 0, pre-absorb 0, no-primary 0, secondary/second antibody 0, knockdown 0, siRNA 0. 'Dissolves rather than adjudicates' verified from the antecedent side: 15982416 carries both 'raised against the WW domains' and 'the recombinant GST-WWOX fusion protein used to raise the antibody', and both are true of one construct. Promotion of the earlier IPOTESI to DATO is warranted.
the_four_claims.2_epitope_deletion_geometry: CONFIRMED in every component, and IPOTESI is the RIGHT strength. Epitope N-terminal in exons 1-3 confirmed on this paper's own Fig. 7 domain bars and Fig. 8 schematic; PEO1 exons 4-8 correctly flagged as an IMPORT (15982416 Methods, ref 4 = Paige 2001), not stated here; 'does not produce full-length WWOX' byte-exact; null lane NOT blank confirmed at 1100 dpi. TWO ADDITIONS: (a) the paper states the geometry consequence ITSELF (entry 8: the antibody recognises epitopes within the WW domains and will also detect proteins encoded by the aberrantly spliced mRNAs), so the inference is the authors' own; (b) the residual band is HIGHER molecular weight whereas an exon-4-8-deleted WW-retaining product must be SMALLER than 46 kDa, so the band cannot be that product and the geometry argument does not depend on it. DATO would over-read; silence would under-read. The two 2005 papers' genetic null is weakened as a claim about MONO-SPECIFICITY and untouched as a claim about the ~46 kDa band being WWOX-dependent.
the_four_claims.3_missing_ladder: CONFIRMED at the resolution the anchor names and at an independent 1100 dpi re-render. Fig. 5A's panel box carries no molecular-weight marks of any kind; the paper's only two marks sit on Fig. 5B and read '85 kd' and '39.5 kd', exactly 45.5 apart. QUALIFIED by omission O1: the Fig. 5 caption's closing comigration sentence is the paper's only bridge from the marked blot to the unmarked panel, and no locator carries it.
the_four_claims.4_genre_finding: CONFIRMED and GENUINELY PRESENT, not pattern-matching imported from PMID 24932569. Every element verified on this paper's own surface: the abstract's 'confirming' against the body's 'preliminary ... manuscript in preparation'; the 'data not shown' SDR-alone result carried as Fig. 8's caption TITLE; the 'unpublished observation' MALDI-TOF identity asserted flatly in Fig. 7's caption; 'necessary and sufficient' byte-exact where Fig. 8 shows only the two mutants that LOSE localisation; and 'see Fig. 7a' where Fig. 7 has no lettered panels. A FOURTH instance was found that the reading does not list — see O1.
